articles.title: What is the Paris climate agreement and why does 1.5C matter?
articles.summary: The 2015 pact is at the heart of the international commitment to tackle rising global temperatures.
articles.body:
In Paris in 2015, almost 200 countries signed a landmark agreement designed to limit global warming to 1.5C and avoid its worst impacts.

But despite some progress in areas like renewable energy, the world has continued to warm at a rapid pace.

A recent UN report said the target was likely to be breached in the next few years and that "urgent and stringent" action would be needed to return the world to 1.5C.

The Paris Agreement is at the heart of the international commitment to tackle rising global temperatures.

It came into force on 4 November 2016 and saw almost all the nations of the world agree to cut the greenhouse gas emissions which cause global warming.

However, the United States - the world's second biggest greenhouse gas emitter - withdrew from the deal in January 2026 under President Donald Trump.

The US also withdrew during Trump's first presidency, but it rejoined in 2021 under his successor President Joe Biden.

The only other UN member states outside the Paris agreement are Iran, Libya and Yemen.

The Paris Agreement lists a series of commitments:

to "pursue efforts" to limit global temperature rises to 1.5C, and to keep them "well below" 2.0C above those recorded in pre-industrial times, generally considered to mean the late 19th Century

to achieve a balance - known as net zero - between the greenhouse gases that humans put into the atmosphere and the gases that they actively remove, in the second half of this century

each country to set its own emission-reduction targets, reviewed every five years to raise ambitions

richer countries to help poorer nations by providing funding, known as climate finance, to adapt to climate change and switch to renewable energy

The 1.5C target is generally accepted to refer to a 20-year average rather than a single year.

So, while 2024 was more than 1.5C warmer than pre-industrial times , it did not mean the Paris Agreement threshold has been breached

Why does keeping global warming to 1.5C matter?

Every 0.1C of warming brings with it greater risks for the planet, such as longer heatwaves, more intense storms and wildfires, according to climate scientists .

But a very large body of scientific evidence shows that warming of 2C or more would bring far greater impacts, on top of those felt at 1.5C, UN scientists say.

more people being exposed to extreme heat

higher sea levels as glaciers and ice sheets melt

increased risks to food security in some regions due to more extreme weather

greater chances of some climate-sensitive diseases spreading, such as dengue

more species being threatened with extinction

Some changes could become irreversible if so-called "tipping points" are crossed.

It is not clear exactly where these sit, but once these thresholds are passed, changes could accelerate and become irreversible.

These could include the collapse of the Greenland Ice Sheet , warm Atlantic Ocean currents or further loss of the Amazon rainforest .

What is net zero and is the UK on track to achieve it?

How climate change worsens heatwaves, droughts, wildfires and floods

What does The Paris Agreement promise for poorer countries?

The Paris deal restated a 2009 commitment that richer countries should provide $100bn (£73bn) annually by 2020 to help developing nations deal with the effects of climate change and build greener economies.

Although only $83.3bn was raised in 2020, data from the OECD shows the goal was reached in each of the three years after 2022.

Almost two-thirds of the money in recent years has gone towards efforts to limit global warming, while around a quarter has been used to help nations adapt to climate change.

In 2023, countries agreed for the first time that a fund should be established exclusively for loss and damage . This is money to help countries recover from the impacts of climate change.

Nepal became the first country approved to receive money from the fund after a flash flood in August 2026 killed more than 1,400 people.

At COP29 in 2024, richer nations committed to providing $300bn (£219bn) a year to developing nations by 2035. Developing countries - which had hoped for more - criticised the "paltry sum".

What has happened since the Paris Agreement?

World leaders meet every year to discuss their climate commitments at international summits known as COPs (Conference of the Parties).

All COPs since 2015 have tracked how countries are building on what they promised in Paris.

At COP28 in 2023 , countries agreed for the first time to "contribute" to "transitioning away from fossil fuels", although they were not forced to take any specific action.

Countries also agreed to treble the global capacity of renewables - such as wind and solar - by 2030.

But the final deal at COP30 in 2025 failed to directly mention fossil fuels. Instead, the host of the conference, Brazil, published a voluntary roadmap for moving away from fossil fuels, which will be discussed at COP31.

That COP is taking place from 9 to 20 November 2026 in Antalya, Turkey and is co-hosted by Australia .

A "coalition of the willing" composed of 57 countries has also organised its own conferences separate from the COP process to discuss phasing out fossil fuels.

The first meeting was held in Santa Marta, Colombia in April 2026, and another conference is scheduled for July 2027 in Tuvalu.

Is the world on track to meet the 1.5C target?

The long-term 1.5C global warming target has not yet been breached.

But the latest UN Emissions Gap Report said the limit was likely to be exceeded in the next few years after "decades of insufficient climate action".

In the "lowest possible" scenario, warming would still reach 1.7 to 1.8C by the mid-century, the report said.

A return to 1.5C by 2100 is possible, but it will require "urgent and stringent cuts to greenhouse emissions", the UN added.

Specifically, emissions would need to be cut by 18% between 2025 and 2030.

The report found that the pledges governments have made so far would only cover half of these cuts.

Without further action, global warming could reach nearly 3C by the end of the century, the research said.

What was agreed on climate change at COP30 in Brazil?

articles.title: How climate change worsens heatwaves, droughts, fires and floods
articles.summary: Rising global temperatures mean extreme weather events are becoming more common and more intense.
articles.body:
Many extreme weather events are becoming more common and more intense around the world, fuelled by human activities such as the burning of fossil fuels.

Here are four ways that rising temperatures are affecting weather extremes.

Even a small increase in average temperatures makes a big difference to heat extremes.

As the range of daily temperatures shifts to warmer levels, hotter days become more likely and more intense.

Scientists use computer models to simulate how individual extreme weather events unfold in two scenarios:

today's world with about 1.4C of human-caused warming

a hypothetical world without human influence on the climate

That way, they can estimate how much a particular heatwave, storm or drought was affected by climate change.

The UK experienced its hottest summer on record in 2026, which the Met Office said was made 130 times more likely by climate change.

Five widespread heatwaves affected the country, resulting in 40 days of temperatures above 30C (86F).

Head of Climate Attribution at the Met Office, Dr Mark McCarthy, described summer 2026 as "remarkable" and warned that extreme heat events would only become more common as the world warms.

What is net zero and is the UK on track to achieve it?

Climate change has also intensified multiple heatwaves across the world this year, according to scientists at the World Weather Attribution group (WWA).

Examples include Australia's worst heatwave in six years in January, the 45C that India experienced in April and Europe's deadly June temperatures .

Heatwaves can happen as a result of heat domes , which are created when an area of high pressure stays over the same area for days or weeks, trapping hot air underneath.

Higher temperatures in the Arctic - which has warmed nearly four times faster than the global average - may be affecting the fast band of winds high in the atmosphere known as the jet stream.

One theory suggests that this is making heat domes more likely, although this is not clear cut.

For every 1C rise in air temperature, the atmosphere can hold about 7% more moisture .

With more moisture available, rainfall can become heavier.

UK winters were 13% wetter in the decade from 2016 to 2025 than between 1961 and 1990, the Met Office says.

However, the large annual variation in rainfall makes it difficult to draw conclusions from a single decade, its scientists warn.

Globally, heavy rainfall events have become more frequent and intense over most land regions due to human activity, according to the UN's climate body, the IPCC .

For example, in October 2025, Hurricane Melissa became one of the strongest hurricanes to ever hit the Caribbean.

WWA researchers found that climate change increased extreme rainfall associated with the storm by 16%.

Linking climate change with specific droughts can be difficult because there are lots of different factors that affect the availability of water.

Natural weather systems like El Niño can play a key role, as was the case with drought in southern Africa in early 2024 .

But climate change is shifting global rainfall patterns. While some of the world is getting wetter, other parts are becoming drier, which can make them more prone to drought.

And heatwaves fuelled by climate change can worsen dry conditions when they do occur by increasing evaporation from the soil.

This makes the air above warm up more quickly, leading to more intense heat.

During periods of hot weather, increased demand for water, especially from farmers, puts even more stress on the water supply.

Severe drought declared and hosepipe bans in force - is your area affected?

Climate-driven heatwaves worsened drought conditions throughout Europe this summer, according to the EU's Joint Research Centre .

Four of Europe's key rivers - the Loire, Po, Rhine and Danube - reached record low levels .

Drought was declared in all of Wales and two-thirds of England, with the highest category - "severe drought" - being used for the first time in parts of southern England.

Elsewhere, the WWA found that climate change intensified a severe drought in Jamaica and Puerto Rico from May 2026.

Global warming made extreme dry conditions 40% more likely in Jamaica and 30% more likely in Puerto Rico, the WWA said.

Fires happen naturally in many parts of the world.

It is difficult to know if climate change has caused or worsened a specific wildfire because other factors are also relevant, such as changes to the way land is used.

But climate change is making the weather conditions needed for wildfires to spread more likely, the IPCC says .

Extreme, long-lasting heat draws more moisture out of soils and vegetation.

These tinder-dry conditions provide fuel for fires, which can spread at incredible speeds, particularly if winds are strong.

In January 2026, fires in Chile and Argentina resulted in 55,000 evacuations. The area burned was around 36% larger due to climate change, according to a global report on wildfires .

More than 5,000 wildfires burned across Canada this summer, resulting in some of the worst air quality levels in the world being recorded in nearby cities.

Climate change made the conditions which enabled the fires to spread twice as likely, according to the WWA .

Many fires are started deliberately or accidentally by humans. But rising temperatures may also increase the likelihood of lightning in some forests, which can in turn trigger more fires.

The combined effects of shifting land use and climate change mean extreme wildfires are projected to become more frequent and intense globally, according to the UN Environment Programme (UNEP) .

The number of the most extreme fires may rise by up to 50% by 2100, UNEP suggests.

2026 was the UK's second worst year for wildfires after 2022, according to provisional data from the housing department.

In Stourbridge, two fires destroyed 19 homes on the hottest day of the year.

articles.title: O que comer antes e depois da corrida? Veja como montar sua dieta | G1
articles.standfirst: Carboidratos, proteínas, frutas e vegetais ajudam a fornecer energia e favorecem a recuperação muscular; veja quais alimentos incluir na rotina e como encontrá-los no supermercado.
articles.summary: Carboidratos, proteínas, frutas e vegetais ajudam a fornecer energia e favorecem a recuperação muscular; veja quais alimentos incluir na rotina e como encontrá-los no supermercado.
articles.body:
Incentivar hábitos saudáveis também significa estimular o movimento, a prática de atividades físicas e escolhas alimentares equilibradas. Essa é uma das propostas dos Supermercados Ítalo, que, além de reunir uma variedade de produtos para quem busca uma alimentação mais saudável, também abre espaço para experiências ligadas ao esporte.

No dia 1º de novembro, o Ítalo Barigui foi palco da primeira edição da Lupo Sport Corre Curitiba, realizada em parceria com a Lupo Sport, e se transformou na arena de encontro dos atletas que participaram da prova. Confira como foi a Corrida Lupo no Ítalo Barigui .

A estrutura do evento ocupou diferentes espaços do supermercado. A entrada do Ítalo Barigui recebeu um ambiente para fotografias dos corredores, o estacionamento externo foi preparado para a largada e a chegada da corrida e o rooftop ganhou um espaço VIP para receber atletas e patrocinadores. A iniciativa reforçou a conexão entre alimentação, atividade física e bem-estar, valores que também estão presentes na proposta da unidade.

Para quem pratica corrida, esse cuidado começa muito antes de chegar à linha de largada. A alimentação tem papel importante na preparação para os treinos, no fornecimento de energia durante o exercício e na recuperação muscular. Saber o que consumir antes e depois de correr, variar os ingredientes e planejar as refeições são atitudes que ajudam a construir uma rotina mais equilibrada.

No Ítalo Barigui, essa organização encontra opções em diferentes setores. O hortifrúti reúne frutas, verduras e legumes frescos para compor refeições variadas, enquanto o setor de saudabilidade oferece produtos integrais, alimentos proteicos, suplementos e outras alternativas para quem deseja cuidar da alimentação. A diversidade de ingredientes permite montar desde um café da manhã reforçado antes do treino até refeições completas para o período de recuperação.

O que comer antes de correr para ter mais energia?

O pré-treino tem como principal objetivo fornecer energia para o exercício sem provocar desconforto durante a atividade. Por isso, os carboidratos ocupam lugar de destaque nessa refeição: eles são convertidos em glicose e armazenados nos músculos e no fígado na forma de glicogênio, uma das principais fontes de combustível utilizadas pelo organismo durante a corrida.

A escolha dos alimentos depende do intervalo entre a refeição e o treinamento. Algumas horas antes de correr, opções como batata-doce, mandioca, arroz, aveia e pães integrais podem compor uma refeição mais completa. Já quando o treino está próximo, frutas como banana, porções de uva-passa ou torradas com geleia podem oferecer energia com digestão mais simples.

A banana é uma das escolhas mais conhecidas entre corredores. Além de fornecer carboidratos, contém potássio, mineral importante para o funcionamento muscular. Pode ser consumida sozinha ou combinada com aveia e iogurte, por exemplo. Para quem tem um treino mais longo pela frente, a aveia também pode fazer parte do café da manhã, acompanhada de frutas.

Outras alternativas são as tâmaras e as uvas-passas, que concentram carboidratos em pequenas porções e podem ser práticas para levar durante atividades prolongadas. A pasta de amendoim também pode entrar em combinações com frutas e pães, embora seja preferível consumi-la com maior antecedência em relação à corrida, devido ao teor de gordura e à digestão mais lenta.

O mais importante é considerar a duração e a intensidade do treinamento, além da tolerância individual. Testar alimentos novos imediatamente antes de uma prova ou treino intenso não é uma boa estratégia.

Alimentação pós-corrida: quais alimentos ajudam na recuperação muscular?

Depois da corrida, o organismo precisa repor parte da energia utilizada e receber nutrientes que participam da recuperação dos músculos. Nesse momento, a combinação de carboidratos e proteínas é especialmente interessante.

Os carboidratos ajudam a recuperar os estoques de glicogênio, enquanto as proteínas fornecem aminoácidos utilizados na reparação e na manutenção dos tecidos musculares.

Entre as opções para o pós-treino estão ovos, frango, peixes, iogurte natural e carnes magras. Ovos mexidos acompanhados de pão integral, um prato com arroz, frango e vegetais ou um iogurte natural com frutas e aveia são exemplos de combinações que podem fazer parte dessa rotina.

Peixes como sardinha e atum também merecem espaço no cardápio. Além das proteínas, algumas espécies fornecem ômega-3, um tipo de gordura associado a benefícios para a saúde cardiovascular e à regulação de processos inflamatórios.

Para quem busca praticidade, iogurtes com maior teor de proteína, atum em conserva e suplementos proteicos podem complementar a alimentação. A escolha depende das necessidades individuais e não substitui a importância de refeições variadas.

Quem busca a corrida como forma de ficar em forma precisa se preocupar com a reposição através dos alimentos corretos. — Foto: Magnific/Divulgação.

Frutas, verduras e legumes também fazem parte da rotina de quem corre

Uma alimentação adequada para corredores não se resume aos alimentos consumidos imediatamente antes ou depois do exercício. A variedade de frutas, verduras e legumes ao longo do dia também contribui para o funcionamento do organismo e para a manutenção da saúde.

Vegetais verde-escuros, como espinafre, couve e brócolis, fornecem nutrientes importantes, entre eles folato, vitamina K e minerais. O ferro, presente em vegetais e também em carnes e leguminosas, participa do transporte de oxigênio pelo sangue e merece atenção na alimentação de quem pratica atividades de resistência.

A beterraba é outro ingrediente conhecido entre praticantes de corrida. Ela contém nitratos naturais, que podem favorecer a circulação sanguínea e a eficiência do exercício em determinadas condições. O suco de beterraba, por exemplo, é estudado como estratégia nutricional para algumas modalidades esportivas.

Frutas vermelhas, como morango, amora e mirtilo, oferecem compostos antioxidantes. Já laranja, acerola, kiwi e outras frutas ricas em vitamina C ajudam na absorção do ferro de origem vegetal.

A variedade é fundamental. Alternar cores, sabores e tipos de vegetais ajuda a ampliar a oferta de nutrientes e evita que a alimentação fique restrita a poucos ingredientes.

Organizar a lista de compras por grupos de alimentos é uma maneira simples de facilitar o planejamento das refeições. Em vez de concentrar as escolhas em poucos produtos, a recomendação é combinar diferentes fontes de carboidratos, proteínas, gorduras e micronutrientes.

Nos Supermercados Ítalo, o setor de hortifrúti reúne frutas, verduras e legumes que podem servir de base para diferentes preparações. A variedade de produtos também permite encontrar ingredientes para lanches, cafés da manhã, almoços e jantares.

Confira algumas opções para incluir na lista:

Pães com farinha integral como primeiro ingrediente;

Iogurte natural e opções com maior teor de proteína;

Morango, amora e outras frutas vermelhas;

Suplementos proteicos, conforme a necessidade individual.

Como organizar as refeições durante a semana?

O planejamento das compras ajuda a evitar improvisos e facilita a manutenção de uma alimentação equilibrada. Uma estratégia é escolher ingredientes que possam ser aproveitados em diferentes refeições, combinando preparações simples e variadas.

Uma mesma compra pode render diferentes opções ao longo da semana:

Café da manhã: aveia com banana e iogurte natural; pão integral com ovos mexidos e uma fruta; ou vitamina de frutas com iogurte.

Pré-treino: banana com aveia, torrada com geleia ou uma porção de frutas. A escolha depende do intervalo até a corrida e da tolerância individual.

Almoço: arroz, frango grelhado, brócolis e cenoura; ou peixe acompanhado de batata-doce e salada de folhas.

Lanche da tarde: iogurte com frutas vermelhas, castanhas ou pão integral com pasta de amendoim.

Jantar: omelete com espinafre e tomate; macarrão com atum e vegetais; ou uma combinação de proteínas, legumes e carboidratos.

A proposta é aproveitar os mesmos ingredientes em preparações diferentes, aumentando a variedade sem tornar a rotina complicada. Também vale higienizar e armazenar corretamente frutas e vegetais para facilitar o consumo durante a semana.

Hidratação também faz parte do treinamento

A alimentação de quem corre precisa estar acompanhada de uma estratégia adequada de hidratação. A água é essencial para regular a temperatura corporal e manter o funcionamento do organismo durante a atividade física.

Em treinos mais curtos e realizados em condições habituais, a água costuma ser suficiente. Já em corridas prolongadas, especialmente sob temperaturas elevadas ou com maior perda de suor, pode ser necessário repor também eletrólitos, como sódio.

A água de coco pode ser uma alternativa para variar a hidratação, pois contém potássio e outros minerais. Entretanto, não substitui necessariamente bebidas formuladas para reposição de eletrólitos em exercícios prolongados. A quantidade de líquidos deve considerar a duração do treino, o clima e as características individuais.

Ítalo Barigui incentiva o esporte e estilo de vida mais saudável

A relação entre alimentação, movimento e bem-estar também faz parte das experiências promovidas pelo Grupo Ítalo. Além de ser palco da primeira edição da Lupo Sport Corre Curitiba, promovida em parceria com a Lupo Sport, o Ítalo possui uma ampla variedade de alimentos saudáveis, inclusive com um setor de saudabilidade.

Para quem corre ou está começando a praticar a modalidade, ter acesso a ingredientes variados e opções que facilitem a organização das refeições é um passo importante. Afinal, uma rotina saudável é construída aos poucos, com escolhas possíveis de manter no dia a dia. E o planejamento das compras pode ser um bom ponto de partida.

articles.title: Por que brasileiros querem morar no Paraguai? Entenda  | G1
articles.standfirst: País recebeu mais de 54 mil solicitações entre janeiro e outubro, superando o total de 2025. Brasileiros receberam 67% das autorizações concedidas no período. Especialista avalia que instabilidade pode reduzir a migração.
articles.summary: País recebeu mais de 54 mil solicitações entre janeiro e outubro, superando o total de 2025. Brasileiros receberam 67% das autorizações concedidas no período.
articles.body:
Os brasileiros receberam quase sete em cada dez autorizações de residência concedidas a estrangeiros no Paraguai entre janeiro e outubro de 2026. Segundo dados divulgados pela Direção Nacional de Migrações do país, foram 34.794 autorizações destinadas a cidadãos brasileiros , o equivalente a 67% do total.

Entre os fatores que ajudam a explicar o interesse dos brasileiros pelo país estão os baixos impostos, oportunidades de negócios e a procura por cursos de Medicina, características que renderam ao Paraguai a fama de "Suíça da América do Sul" entre empresários e investidores.

O levantamento também mostra que os pedidos de residência de estrangeiros no Paraguai cresceram 42% em relação ao mesmo período de 2025. Foram 54.344 solicitações nos dez primeiros meses deste ano, número que já supera o total registrado ao longo de todo o ano passado.

O crescimento ocorre em meio a uma crise bancária e política no Paraguai. Na terça-feira (3), o Banco Central do país suspendeu as operações do Ueno Bank , após identificar problemas na situação financeira da instituição, deixando clientes, incluindo brasileiros, sem acesso ao dinheiro depositado.

A instabilidade também chegou ao cenário político. Nesta sexta-feira (6), foi retomada a sessão que analisa o processo de impeachment do presidente paraguaio , Santiago Peña . Peña chegou a anunciar que iria renunciar ao cargo, mas a Câmara dos Deputados optou pela abertura do processo que pode destituir o presidente.

Ueno Bank no Paraguai — Foto: Marcos Landim/RPC

Para o pesquisador em relações entre Brasil e Paraguai e professor da Universidade Federal da Integração Latino-Americana (Unila), Aníbal Orué Pozzo, a instabilidade pode reduzir a chegada de novos moradores e investidores nos próximos anos.

Segundo Pozzo, o crescimento da presença brasileira no país vizinho é resultado de uma política de atração de investimentos e estrangeiros desenvolvida ao longo de mais de uma década. A estratégia ganhou força durante o governo de Horacio Cartes, em 2013, e foi mantida pelas administrações seguintes.

“Nos últimos 12 anos, o Paraguai estruturou uma política para atrair investimentos e pessoas do Brasil. O que vemos hoje é resultado desse processo”, explica.

Fila com brasileiros vira a madrugada em Ciudad del Este, no Paraguai — Foto: Fernando Otto/BBC

O pesquisador também destaca a criação, em abril de 2026, de uma modalidade de residência voltada a investidores, chamada de Paraguay Investor Pass. Segundo ele, a medida prevê condições específicas para estrangeiros que pretendem investir no país, incluindo investimentos a partir de US$ 70 mil, associados a um plano de negócios e à geração de empregos.

Além dos empresários, os estudantes brasileiros também representam uma parcela importante dos estrangeiros que buscam residência no Paraguai. Segundo dados da Direção Nacional de Migrações, o país concedeu 12.617 autorizações de residência a estudantes brasileiros em 2025, um aumento de 56% em relação a 2022, quando foram registradas 8.098.

O levantamento mostra que esse número cresceu em todos os anos do período. Foram 9.627 autorizações em 2023 e 11.349 em 2024.

Os números não representam necessariamente a quantidade de estudantes brasileiros que vivem atualmente no país, uma vez que contabilizam autorizações concedidas ao longo dos anos.

Estudante de Medicina no Paraguai. — Foto: Fonte: Assessoria.

Segundo Pozzo, a procura por cursos de Medicina é um dos fatores que ajudam a explicar a presença brasileira no país vizinho. Ele afirma que esse movimento também envolve familiares que acompanham os estudantes durante a formação.

“Os estudantes também vêm acompanhados de familiares, como pais e irmãos, o que contribui para aumentar a presença de brasileiros no Paraguai. Parte desse fluxo migratório está ligada à procura por cursos de Medicina”, explica

'Recebemos e acordamos no outro dia sem nada do dinheiro', diz mulher que teve valores bloqueados após quebra do Ueno Bank no Paraguai

Crise pode reduzir chegada de brasileiros

Agência do Ueno Bank fechada em Pedro Juan Caballero. — Foto: Nádia Nicolau/TV Morena

Apesar do crescimento registrado nos últimos anos, Pozzo avalia que a crise política e bancária pode afetar a confiança de estrangeiros que pretendem se estabelecer no Paraguai.

O pesquisador afirma que a facilidade para abrir contas e movimentar dinheiro no Ueno Bank ajudou a atrair brasileiros para a instituição. Com a suspensão das operações, parte desses investidores também passou a enfrentar dificuldades para acessar seus recursos.

"Evidentemente, a crise pode frear o aumento da migração de brasileiros para o Paraguai, sem dúvida. Se não existe uma estabilidade política, social ou econômica, obviamente as pessoas não vão migrar para um país que tem essa situação", afirma.

O pesquisador ressalta, porém, que os próximos movimentos migratórios dependerão da forma como o país enfrentará a crise.

“Então, sem nenhuma dúvida, vamos ter que observar de que forma o Paraguai vai se estabilizar para ver se esse processo vai continuar atraindo os brasileiros para o Paraguai.”

Brasileiros afetados pela crise bancária

A crise envolvendo o Ueno Bank, um dos maiores bancos digitais do Paraguai, também afetou brasileiros que vivem no país e utilizavam a instituição para movimentar dinheiro e pagar despesas do dia a dia.

Entre eles está a empreendedora Jhenifer Vogado, filha de brasileiros e moradora de Santa Rosa del Monday, cidade paraguaia a cerca de 57 quilômetros de Foz do Iguaçu, no oeste do Paraná.

Ela precisou recorrer à ajuda de familiares para comprar medicamentos para o filho de 3 anos, que está doente, depois de ficar sem acesso ao dinheiro da conta bancária.

Jhenifer e o marido utilizavam o Ueno como banco principal havia cerca de quatro anos.

"A gente dependia dele para tudo: para pagar mercado, para pagar internet, para pagar a luz, para fazer transferência, para tudo. A gente dormiu com o salário que recebemos no começo do mês e acordamos no outro dia sem nada do dinheiro, nada", detalha.

Jhenifer afirma que soube da situação pelas redes sociais e que não recebeu comunicação oficial do banco naquele momento.

"Eu não tinha a cabeça para nada. Meu emocional estava abaladíssimo. Foi um sentimento de tristeza, porque, além de nós estarmos precisando, tem mais famílias que estão sem dinheiro. Por sorte, a gente tem alguém que possa nos emprestar, mas e as pessoas que não têm? Que dependiam desse salário do mês? Como que essas pessoas ficam sem comida, sem acesso a remédio?", lamentou.

Outra brasileira afetada é Camila Brito, natural de Foz do Iguaçu e estudante de Medicina em Assunção, capital paraguaia.

Ela precisou renegociar o aluguel e outras contas depois que teve valores e investimentos bloqueados.

"É uma situação muito complicada acordar e não ter acesso nenhum ao seu próprio dinheiro, ainda mais no dia seguinte ao tradicional dia de pagamento dos salários. Isso significa que as pessoas, inclusive nós, havíamos acabado de receber e não tínhamos como cumprir as nossas obrigações financeiras. No geral, as pessoas estão sendo solidárias e permitindo que as despesas sejam renegociadas. O que resta agora é esperar que os valores sejam desbloqueados o mais rápido possível", afirma.

Não há, nas informações disponíveis, um levantamento oficial sobre quantos brasileiros foram afetados pela suspensão das operações do Ueno Bank.

articles.summary: O atropelamento em Teresina ocorreu no bairro Mafrense, onde o condutor atingiu as vítimas na calçada e fugiu a pé após abandonar o veículo em uma rua próxima.
articles.body:
Três pessoas ficaram feridas após serem atingidas por um carro no bairro Mafrense, na Zona Norte de Teresina , na tarde desta sexta-feira (6). Entre elas está um idoso, que sofreu ferimentos graves.

O motorista fugiu sem prestar socorro e, até a última atualização desta reportagem, não havia sido localizado.

Ao g1 , o perito criminal Marcos Pinheiro informou que o condutor trafegava pela Rua Teodoro quando atingiu um ciclista.

Em seguida, colidiu com um carro estacionado e uma motocicleta ocupada por uma pessoa. Ao chegar a um cruzamento, o motorista atropelou uma mulher que estava em uma calçada.

Ainda de acordo com o perito, após o atropelamento, o motorista abandonou o veículo em uma rua próxima ao local do acidente e deixou a região antes da chegada da polícia.

O carro foi encontrado posteriormente na região do Bairro São Joaquim. As primeiras informações indicam que o veículo pertence a uma moradora do Paraná.

Equipes do Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência (Samu) foram acionadas, prestaram os primeiros socorros às vítimas e as encaminharam para uma unidade de saúde.

Até a última atualização desta reportagem, não havia informações detalhadas sobre o estado de saúde dos feridos.

articles.title: Otávio Lessa: TJAL libera posse na presidência da Arsal | G1
articles.standfirst: Nomeação havia sido suspensa por decisão judicial no início da semana. Presidente do TJAL derrubou a medida nesta sexta-feira (6).
articles.summary: O presidente do TJAL liberou a posse de Otávio Lessa na Arsal ao considerar que não há provas de ilegalidade na nomeação questionada pelo governador eleito JHC.
articles.body:
O presidente do Tribunal de Justiça de Alagoas (TJAL), desembargador Fábio Bittencourt, derrubou, nesta sexta-feira (6), a decisão que impedia Otávio Lessa de assumir a presidência da Agência Reguladora de Serviços Públicos de Alagoas (Arsal).

Com isso, a nomeação volta a ter validade, e ele está autorizado a tomar posse no cargo. A decisão atende a um pedido do Governo de Alagoas e da própria Arsal.

A disputa começou no fim de outubro, quando Lessa foi indicado para comandar a agência pelo governador em exercício, Marcelo Victor (MDB).

A escolha, no entanto, foi contestada por JHC na Justiça.

Em decisão assinada no domingo (1º) e divulgada na segunda-feira (2), o juiz Léo Dennisson Bezerra de Almeida suspendeu a nomeação e proibiu Lessa de tomar posse ou exercer as funções de presidente da Arsal.

O magistrado apontou indícios de possível desvio de finalidade, ao considerar que a vaga estava aberta desde setembro de 2024, mas só foi preenchida após as eleições.

Também levou em conta a rapidez do processo e uma mudança recente na legislação, que estabeleceu mandatos de cinco anos para os dirigentes da agência.

Com a suspensão, a atual diretora-presidente, Camilla Ferraz, deveria permanecer na função.

Após a suspensão, o Governo de Alagoas e a Arsal recorreram ao Tribunal de Justiça para tentar restabelecer a nomeação.

Ao analisar o pedido, o desembargador Fábio Bittencourt entendeu que não foram apresentadas provas concretas de ilegalidade ou desvio de finalidade que justificassem a suspensão nesta fase do processo.

Ele também destacou que a indicação seguiu as regras previstas na legislação estadual, incluindo a aprovação pela Assembleia Legislativa.

Outro ponto considerado foi a atuação do juiz que concedeu a primeira decisão. Segundo Bittencourt, não ficou demonstrada uma situação de urgência que justificasse a análise do caso durante o plantão judiciário.

Além de liberar a nomeação, o presidente do TJAL determinou o envio do processo à Corregedoria-Geral da Justiça, que deverá avaliar a atuação do magistrado responsável pela suspensão inicial.

Não. A nova decisão permite que Otávio Lessa tome posse e exerça a presidência da Arsal, mas não significa que a Justiça tenha considerado a nomeação definitivamente legal.

A ação apresentada por JHC continuará tramitando, e a legalidade da escolha ainda poderá ser analisada pela Justiça.

articles.title: Morte de garçom de bares tradicionais de Goiânia causa comoção | G1
articles.standfirst: Ademir Ribeiro dos Santos, de 47 anos, trabalhou em estabelecimentos como Bola Sete, Carlota e Simprão. Amigos e colegas de profissão destacaram sua trajetória e dedicação ao trabalho.
articles.summary: Ademir Ribeiro dos Santos, de 47 anos, trabalhou em bares como Bola Sete, Carlota e Simprão. Amigos e colegas homenagearam o profissional nas redes sociais.
articles.body:
Morte de Ademir Ribeiro dos Santos causa comoção em Goiás — Foto: Arquivo pessoal/Kerolayne Ribeiro

A morte do garçom e ex-gerente de bares tradicionais de Goiânia , Ademir Ribeiro dos Santos, de 47 anos, causou comoção entre amigos, colegas de trabalho e conhecidos na capital. O profissional morreu em decorrência de um tromboembolismo pulmonar, condição que, segundo a sobrinha Kerolayne Ribeiro, Ademir não sabia que tinha.

A morte ocorreu no domingo (1), segundo a família. De acordo com a sobrinha, Ademir sofreu uma queda de moto e machucou a perna. Durante esse período, acabou desenvolvendo o quadro.

“Ficamos sabendo apenas com a autópsia. Foi uma complicação grave que, infelizmente, levou ao seu falecimento”, disse Kerolayne.

A sobrinha também descreveu Ademir como uma pessoa alegre, responsável e querida por todos. Ele gostava de estar com a família, compartilhar momentos e manter por perto as pessoas que amava.

“Meu tio era uma pessoa de alegria contagiante. Por onde passava, deixava sua marca, sempre levando descontração e fazendo as pessoas ao seu redor sorrirem. Gostava muito de estar com a família, de compartilhar momentos e estar perto das pessoas que amava. Deixa três filhos e muitas saudades entre familiares, amigos e todos que tiveram a oportunidade de conviver com ele.”

Kerolayne também destacou a dor da família com a perda e afirmou que Ademir será lembrado não apenas pela trajetória profissional, mas principalmente pelas qualidades pessoais e pelas amizades que construiu ao longo da vida.

“Sua partida foi uma perda muito dolorosa para todos nós. Ademir era uma pessoa muito querida, que construiu amizades ao longo da vida e deixou lembranças por onde passou. Mais do que sua trajetória profissional, será lembrado pela pessoa alegre, dedicada e companheira que sempre foi”, afirmou.

Ao g1 , o cantor e amigo de longa data de Ademir, Cristiano Kauzne, destacou as qualidades pessoais e profissionais do colega e relembrou sua passagem por estabelecimentos como Bola Sete, Carlota e Simprão.

"O Ademir era uma pessoa maravilhosa. Conheci ele há muitos anos. Sempre foi um cara muito fácil de lidar, um ser humano incrível, um grande profissional, sem soberba, sem ego", afirmou.

Cristiano destacou a generosidade e a simplicidade do profissional, a quem classificou como alguém admirável e de fácil convivência.

"Ele trabalhou muitos anos no Bola Sete e na Carlota, onde também foi gerente por muitos anos. Por último, trabalhou no Simprão e agora estava em outra casa", relatou o amigo.

Reconhecimento pela trajetória profissional

O Sindicato Intermunicipal dos Empregados no Comércio Hoteleiro do Estado de Goiás (Sechseg) publicou nas redes sociais uma nota sobre a morte do garçom e sua dedicação ao trabalho. No texto, o presidente Marlos Luz destacou a trajetória profissional de Ademir em estabelecimentos tradicionais de Goiânia, como Bola Sete e Simprão.

“Desde sua adolescência trabalhou como garçom e gerente em estabelecimentos tradicionais goianos, como no Bola 7 e no Simprão. Sendo reconhecido sempre por sua honestidade e dedicação”, escreveu.

articles.title: Gold, silver or steel: What should you actually buy on Dhanteras?
articles.summary: When you think about stepping out to shop on Dhanteras, gold is usually the first thing that pops into your head.
articles.body: When you think about stepping out to shop on Dhanteras, gold is usually the first thing that pops into your head. But silver and even a humble steel utensil have a long-standing place in the celebrations, too.So, how do you navigate the annual dilemma? Should you spend on gold, pick up a few silver coins or simply bring home a new vessel for your kitchen?For many families, buying gold is an annual tradition. Others prefer silver, while plenty of households stick to something practical for the home. And with gold prices hovering near record highs, people are understandably thinking twice before making a purchase.Here's a look at how gold, silver and steel compare, both culturally and practically, so you can decide what makes sense for your budget.Why do we buy metals on Dhanteras in the first place?Dhanteras, also known as Dhantrayodashi, falls on the thirteenth lunar day of Krishna Paksha during the Hindu month of Kartik. The festival is associated with Goddess Lakshmi, Lord Kubera and Lord Dhanvantari.Lord Dhanvantari is revered as the deity of health and Ayurveda. According to the story of Samudra Manthan, or the churning of the cosmic ocean, he emerged carrying a kalash filled with amrita, the nectar of immortality. This association with a vessel is one reason why bringing home new metal utensils became part of the Dhanteras tradition.The Bhagavata Purana (Canto 8, Chapter 8) describes Dhanvantari's emergence during the churning of the ocean. However, it doesn't specifically instruct people to buy gold, silver or steel. These shopping customs developed over time around the festival's association with wealth and prosperity.That's worth remembering. Buying a particular metal is a popular tradition, not a religious rule that every household must follow.1. Gold: The traditional favouriteGold is easily the most popular Dhanteras purchase, especially among families who see the occasion as an opportunity to add to their jewellery collection or long-term savings.The metal has long been associated with Goddess Lakshmi, wealth and good fortune. But there's a financial reason behind its popularity, too. Gold is traded globally and attracts demand from investors, central banks and jewellery buyers.According to the World Gold Council's Gold as a Strategic Asset 2026 report, gold has historically helped diversify investment portfolios and preserve value over longer periods. That said, its price doesn't always move upwards. Gold can experience sharp fluctuations, with annual price movements sometimes approaching 30%.What should you buy?24-karat gold coins: A good option if purity and easy storage are your priorities.22-karat jewellery: Suitable if you want something you can wear while retaining precious-metal value.Gold bars: Worth considering if your primary intention is investment.One thing to remember: jewellery comes with making charges, which you may not recover when you sell it. If you're buying gold purely as an investment, coins or bars may be more suitable.2. Silver: The more affordable alternativeIf you don't want to spend a large amount on gold, silver is another popular choice for Dhanteras.From Lakshmi-Ganesha coins and small bars to jewellery and puja utensils, there's plenty to choose from across different budgets. For many families, buying a silver coin, worshipping it during Diwali and keeping it safely is an annual ritual.But silver isn't simply a cheaper version of gold.The World Gold Council points out that silver tends to be more volatile than gold. A large part of its demand comes from industries such as solar energy, electronics and electrical equipment. This means its price is influenced by industrial activity and global economic conditions, apart from jewellery and investment demand.What should you buy?999 fine silver coins: Check the purity details before purchasing.925 sterling silver jewellery: A popular option for everyday accessories.Silver utensils and puja items: Useful additions to a household collection.A quick tip: Look for BIS hallmarking and the HUID number when buying eligible hallmarked silver articles. You can use the BIS Care app to verify the six-digit identification code before making the purchase.3. Steel: Does a kitchen vessel count as a Dhanteras purchase?This is where family traditions can differ.Stainless steel doesn't have the investment value of gold or silver, but bringing home new utensils is a common way of celebrating Dhanteras.The practice is often linked to Lord Dhanvantari's amrita kalash. Over time, families began buying new vessels made of brass, copper, silver and, eventually, stainless steel.There are regional differences, though. Some households avoid buying iron or steel on Dhanteras because of traditional associations with Shani Dev. Others have no such restriction and make a point of purchasing new kitchenware every year. There is no universal scriptural prohibition against buying steel.From a practical standpoint, stainless steel is a sensible choice. It's durable, relatively affordable and useful for everyday cooking and serving.The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) has a dedicated standard, IS 14756, for stainless steel utensils. It covers requirements such as material quality, thickness, workmanship and safety.What should you buy?A stainless steel dinner set for everyday use.Serving bowls, platters or cooking pots.Storage containers for your kitchen.Just check for the ISI mark and avoid choosing utensils purely because they're cheap or look shiny.What do ancient Hindu texts actually say about buying metals?The religious references behind Dhanteras are worth looking at more closely.The Bhagavata Purana (Canto 8, Chapter 8, verses 33–35) describes Lord Dhanvantari emerging from the ocean during Samudra Manthan, carrying a pot of amrita. The account establishes his association with Lord Vishnu, healing and Ayurveda.The Skanda Purana is also associated with the tradition of lighting a lamp for Lord Yama on Trayodashi, commonly known as Yamadeepdaan. The ritual is observed with the belief that it helps ward off untimely death.But there's no ancient shopping checklist that says every household must purchase gold or silver on this day.As discussed by author Amish Tripathi in a conversation about Indian cultural traditions, buying gold on Dhanteras is largely a folk custom that developed over time rather than a strict scriptural requirement.So, whether you bring home a small silver coin or a gold bar, you can still celebrate the festival without making an expensive purchase.When should you shop? Check the PanchangIf your family follows auspicious timings for festival shopping and puja, checking the local Panchang is a good idea.For Dhanteras on November 6, 2026, the timings listed for Mumbai are:Trayodashi Tithi begins: 10:30 am on November 6, 2026.Trayodashi Tithi ends: 10:47 am on November 7, 2026.Lakshmi-Kubera evening puja muhurat: 6:35 pm to 8:35 pm on November 6, 2026.These timings are location-specific. The auspicious window for buying metals may also differ from the evening puja muhurat, so check your city's Panchang before planning your purchase.You can refer to a Panchang for the local timings.Gold vs silver vs steel: How do they compare?FactorGoldSilverSteelTraditional appealVery highVery highDepends on family customCostHighModerateAffordableInvestment valueEstablished precious-metal assetPrecious-metal asset, more volatileNo meaningful investment valueEveryday useJewelleryJewellery and puja itemsCooking and servingWhat to checkBIS hallmark and HUIDBIS hallmark and HUIDISI markSo, what should you buy this Dhanteras?There's no single right answer. It really comes down to your budget, family traditions and what you actually need.Choose gold if you can comfortably afford it and want to add to your family's long-term savings or jewellery collection.Choose silver if you'd like to bring home a precious metal without spending as much as you would on gold. Coins and puja items are particularly popular choices.Choose steel if practicality matters more to you. A good-quality cooking pot or dinner set is something your family can use every day.And don't let shopping pressure dictate how much you spend. Dhanteras is about welcoming prosperity, health and good fortune into your home. There's little point in taking on unnecessary financial stress just to keep up with a tradition.Whether it's a silver coin, a sturdy steel vessel or a gold pendant, buy what works for your home and your pocket. That's reason enough to celebrate.Get the latest movie news, reviews, and celebrity updates. Download the TOI App.

articles.title: ‘Vote gone, rights gone’: Rahul alleges BJP conspiracy in schemes linked with voter ID instead of Aadhaar
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Friday launched a sharp attack on the Centre over Union Minister Rajiv Ranjan Singh's announcement that voter
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Friday launched a sharp attack on the Centre over Union Minister Rajiv Ranjan Singh's announcement that voter ID cards would be used instead of Aadhaar to identify beneficiaries of social welfare programmes under the ministry of panchayati raj.Calling the move a "conspiracy", the leader of opposition in the Lok Sabha alleged that linking welfare benefits to voter IDs could put people's access to government schemes at risk.In a post on X, Rahul claimed that the announcement was part of a wider attempt to remove names from electoral rolls through the Special Intensive Revision (SIR). He alleged that millions of names were being deleted under the exercise and that those most critical of the BJP were being targeted."Modi government minister's announcement - Benefits of schemes will now be determined not by Aadhaar, but by Voter ID. The conspiracy runs very deep—take your time to understand it. Under the guise of SIR, millions of names are being struck off voter lists—if not stopped, even more will be removed. Whose names are being targeted the most? Those who are furious with the BJP," Rahul said.He also accused the Election Commission of India (ECI) of colluding with the BJP, alleging that electoral rolls were no longer being maintained by an impartial body. Rahul named Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, accusing him of being a "Modi government employee" and claiming that his alleged collusion with the BJP in "vote theft" had been exposed with evidence."The preparation is underway to craft such a list where the majority is always BJP's—and now that very list will decide whether you get scheme benefits or not. Anyone who decided yesterday that the BJP must go—will have their names cherry-picked and struck off. Name struck—vote gone. Vote gone—rights gone. And just like that, you'll become invisible citizens of a hijacked democracy—where the people don't elect the government, the government selects its people," he added.Rahul further warned that making voter ID mandatory for welfare benefits could eventually affect access to ration, pensions, MGNREGA wages, housing assistance, scholarships and reservations. He argued that voting rights should not be made a condition for receiving welfare benefits."Today, Panchayati Raj schemes. Tomorrow, rations? Pensions? MGNREGA? Housing? Scholarships? Reservations? This isn't politics to win elections—it's an arrangement to steal elections and a permanent setup to cling to power.Voting is your right, not a condition. A poor person's pension cannot be enslaved to their voter card. This isn't just vote theft—it's rights theft. We won't let this happen," he said.Singh, also known as Lallan Singh, had announced that beneficiaries seeking financial assistance and welfare payments under schemes of the Ministry of Panchayati Raj would need to provide an Elector's Photo Identity Card (EPIC) number and undergo mandatory biometric authentication. The proposed system would use voter ID instead of Aadhaar for identifying beneficiaries.The announcement has raised questions about the scope of the move, as the Ministry of Panchayati Raj does not directly operate schemes involving payments to individual beneficiaries. Aadhaar is currently used for beneficiary identification and payments under several other central government programmes, including rural housing assistance, PM-KISAN and social security pensions.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: SC ends decades-old power tussle, Himachal to get 11,973 MU from Punjab, Haryana
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: The Supreme Court on Monday settled a decades-old inter-state dispute over unpaid electricity dues from Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB)
articles.body: NEW DELHI: The Supreme Court on Monday settled a decades-old inter-state dispute over unpaid electricity dues from Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB) projects, directing Punjab and Haryana to provide Himachal Pradesh with 11,973 million units (MU) of electricity over 20 years. A bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant, along with Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana, accepted the Centre's proposal to clear the outstanding dues through an energy-based settlement instead of a cash payment.The settlement follows a 2011 Supreme Court verdict that recognised Himachal Pradesh's entitlement to a 7.19 per cent share in the electricity generated by the Bhakra Nangal and Beas hydroelectric projects. The dues date back to 1966, but Punjab and Haryana had not cleared the state's outstanding share for the period before November 2011.Under the arrangement approved by the top court, Punjab and Haryana will provide the electricity over 20 years. The settlement also factors in an adjustment of around Rs 420 crore towards Himachal Pradesh's share of the historical capital costs incurred in building the dams. As a result, the hill state will not have to make any separate payment to Punjab or Haryana.The Centre had earlier proposed that the 13,066 MU in outstanding electricity dues be paid over 15 years, at the rate of 871 MU annually during the lean seasons between October and March. However, the states could not agree on the proposed timeline.Punjab initially opposed the 15-year arrangement and later sought to extend the payment period to 30 years. Himachal Pradesh, on the other hand, wanted the dues cleared within 10 years. The Supreme Court's decision to settle the matter over 20 years brings an end to the prolonged disagreement over the payment schedule.The original electricity arrears were calculated at 13,066 MU by the Central Electricity Authority (CEA). The Centre's proposal had also factored in Himachal Pradesh's liability towards the capital costs of the Bhakra Nangal and Beas projects.According to a report by PTI, the proposal says that Himachal Pradesh's liability was assessed at Rs 420.7 crore, comprising Rs 249.2 crore payable to Punjab and Rs 171.5 crore to Haryana. This represented the state's 7.19 per cent share of the composite of Punjab's outstanding loan-servicing costs for the projects since 1966-67.The Centre had suggested setting off this liability against a portion of the electricity arrears. At the proposed rate of Rs 3.85 per unit, around 1,093 MU would have been adjusted against the capital cost liability.The proposal also provided for the distribution of electricity arrears between Punjab and Haryana in the inter-state ratio of 58:42 for the Bhakra Nangal project and 60:40 for the Beas projects. However, since the states could not reach a consensus on the applicable electricity rate, the Centre recommended settling the dues in energy terms.What was the 2011 Supreme Court verdict?The Supreme Court's 2011 decision fixed Himachal Pradesh's share in the BBMB projects at 7.19 per cent. Punjab's share was set at 51.80 per cent, while Haryana was allocated 37.51 per cent. Rajasthan's share largely remained unchanged, and Chandigarh's share was fixed at 3.50 per cent.The verdict also specified when Himachal Pradesh's entitlement would take effect for the three projects. The state was entitled to a share in the Bhakra project from November 1, 1966, the Dehar project from November 1977 and the Pong Dam project from January 1978.The BBMB has been providing Himachal Pradesh with its 7.19 per cent share of electricity from these projects since November 1, 2011, PTI reported, citing sources. However, Punjab and Haryana had not cleared the outstanding dues for the earlier period, amounting to 13,066 MU.How did the dispute reach the Supreme Court?The dispute dates back to the reorganisation of Punjab under the Punjab Reorganisation Act, 1966. Himachal Pradesh maintained that, as a successor state, it was entitled to a 7.19 per cent share in the BBMB projects and their electricity generation.After efforts to resolve the disagreement between the neighbouring states failed, Himachal Pradesh approached the Supreme Court in 1996 through an original suit. It sought recognition of its entitlement to a share in the projects and the payment of the corresponding arrears.The Centre subsequently attempted to settle the matter outside court. However, with no agreement emerging between the states, the Supreme Court passed a decree on September 27, 2011, upholding Himachal Pradesh's 7.19 per cent entitlement.The latest order accepting the Centre's energy-based settlement provides a mechanism to clear the accumulated dues and closes a dispute that has remained unresolved for decades.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: UK Henry Nowak murder case: Court increases Vickrum Digwa's minimum term to 25 years after ruling 21-year sentence 'unduly lenient'
articles.summary: The Court of Appeal has increased Vickrum Digwa's minimum term for the murder of student Henry Nowak to 25 years, ruling the previous 21-year sentence as unduly lenient. The decision comes after challenges from both the Attorney General and Digwa regarding the severity of the sentence.
articles.body: Vickrum Digwa, Sikh man who was sentenced to life imprisonment for killing 18-year-old student Henry Nowak in Southampton, will have to serve at least 25 years before becoming eligible for parole after the Court of Appeal increased his minimum term from 21 years.The decision followed a challenge by Attorney General Ellie Reeves, who argued that the original sentence was unduly lenient. Digwa had also appealed against the term, describing it as manifestly excessive. However, the court rejected his challenge and ruled that the original punishment failed to reflect the full seriousness of the offence, according to BBC.Digwa stabbed Nowak with a large dagger on Belmont Road, Southampton, on December 3 last year. The 22-year-old was sentenced to life imprisonment at Southampton Crown Court in June.The appeals were heard on Thursday by Lady Chief Justice Baroness Carr, alongside Mr Justice Nicklin and Mr Justice Wall. Digwa attended the proceedings through a video link from HMP Frankland.In delivering the ruling, Baroness Carr said the trial judge was entitled to set a starting point of 15 years because Digwa had not brought the weapon to the scene with the intention of committing a crime. However, she said the use of a large kirpan required a substantial increase in the minimum term.A kirpan is a religious blade that baptised Sikhs are expected to carry. UK law permits Sikhs to carry such knives in public for religious purposes. Digwa wore a smaller kirpan around his neck but also carried a larger blade secured to his belt, following the practices of the Nihang order.The court said the lawful possession of the weapon did not lessen the seriousness of using it to kill someone. Baroness Carr said the earlier sentence had failed to account adequately for the repeated use of the dagger, the intention to kill and the suffering inflicted on Nowak, as well as the obstruction that followed."It was not only lenient, but unduly so," she said.After accounting for the time Digwa has already spent in custody on remand, he must serve at least 24 years and 190 days before he can be considered for parole, as per the outlet.Nowak's family described the increased sentence as "an important step towards justice" but said it could not compensate for their loss."No sentence, however long, can ever give Henry his life back," the family said in a statement, as cited by BBC.They added that they had been left with "a life sentence of grief", saying there was no reduction in their suffering and no possibility of getting their son back. The family also said their pursuit of justice was continuing and expressed support for an independent rapid review being carried out by Alex Chalk.Attorney General Reeves said the brutality of the killing had deeply affected her and expressed sympathy for Nowak's family."No sentence can ever fill the void left by his loss, and I hope this outcome goes some way towards bringing them the justice they deserve," she said.During the appeal hearing, Jonathan Polnay KC, representing the Attorney General, argued that the original 21-year minimum term did not reflect the seriousness of the crime. He said Digwa had taken advantage of the legal exemption permitting Sikhs to carry religious blades, describing the circumstances as comparable, in some respects, to an abuse of trust.Imran Khan KC, representing Digwa, argued that the trial judge had counted some aggravating factors more than once. He maintained that the original term was already excessive, saying: "To put it pithily, the Attorney General says 21 years was too little. We say it was too much."The appeal judges agreed that certain factors should not have been treated as aggravating circumstances, including the wider impact of the killing on the community, which Digwa had neither anticipated nor intended.Digwa's mother, Kiran Kaur, was sentenced to three years in prison in July for assisting an offender by removing the murder weapon from the scene. She withdrew her challenge against that sentence shortly before Thursday's hearing.Digwa has separately applied for permission to appeal against his murder conviction. That application will be considered independently of the sentencing decision.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.body: Far-right political influencer Laura Loomer has announced that she is taking a hiatus from her twice-weekly livestreamed show, Loomer Unleashed, saying she needs to focus on her personal life, family and upcoming wedding after spending years working almost around the clock to support US President Donald Trump. Loomer made the announcement in a lengthy post on X on Thursday night, November 5, 2026. She clarified that she was not quitting political commentary or withdrawing her support for Trump, but would temporarily stop hosting her show."I’ve been going nonstop supporting President Trump @realDonaldTrump ever since he came down the golden escalator. As many of you know, I am chronically tuned in, online, and I am always working. I am a machine. Some days I work more than 18 hours," she wrote.Explaining her decision, Loomer said she had been neglecting her personal life and relationships because of her work. She said she had been "running on empty for too long" and wanted to establish a healthier balance between her professional commitments and private life."There is more to life than work though, and I am trying to learn that and practice it. It’s been very hard for me to be honest. Very very hard," she said.Loomer said her family, personal life and upcoming wedding had been put on hold because of her work. She also said she wanted to spend more time with her partner and participate in wedding planning."So I’m taking a hiatus from my show @LoomerUnleashed, which I livestream twice a week. I just need to step back, recharge, refocus, and be present in my own life and my own mind with peace and clarity for a little while," she wrote.She also said she wanted to redesign her studio, something she had been postponing for nearly a year because of her professional commitments."I have wanted to redo my studio for a year, but I keep pushing it all off, because that’s what I do. I push things off that matter to me and my happiness to do for others 24/7, and I think I need to change that for a brief moment," she said.Will Laura Loomer stop political commentary?Loomer made it clear that her decision to suspend the show does not mean she is stepping away from politics or her support for Trump. She said she would continue following developments, researching stories and commenting on breaking news."I’ll still be paying attention, fully supporting President Trump, breaking news, commenting on news, doing research and I’ll be around. I will be present (I always am)," she wrote.Regarding the resumption of her show, she did not announce a specific date. Instead, she said she would resume hosting it when she felt the time was right."I’ll be back when the time is right," she said, thanking viewers who had followed the programme.Who is Laura Loomer?Loomer is a conservative political activist and social media personality who has become a prominent supporter of Trump. Although she does not hold an official position in his administration, she has developed a close relationship with the president and is known for her influence within his political circle.She has frequently used social media to criticise political opponents, Republican officials she considers insufficiently loyal to Trump and conservative commentators who disagree with the president.Her influence has also attracted controversy. articles.title: 'Domestic feud, humiliation, resentment towards in-laws': What drove Bengaluru man to kill 7 members of wife's family?
articles.summary: BENGALURU: A prolonged marital dispute, resentment towards his wife's family and alleged humiliation appear to have led to the killing of seven members of
articles.body: BENGALURU: A prolonged marital dispute, resentment towards his wife's family and alleged humiliation appear to have led to the killing of seven members of a family in Bengaluru's Srirampura locality.Police suspect that the accused, Indushekar, was angered by his wife Sunita's frequent visits to her parental home and the support she received from her mother and brothers.Karnataka minister Priyank Kharge said on Friday that the accused had claimed he was humiliated by his wife's family. He also indicated that the killings appeared to have been pre-planned."It is a very unfortunate incident and looks like it was pre-planned within the family. The accused claims that he was humiliated by his wife's side," Kharge said, as quoted by news agency ANI.The couple had been married for around 20 years and frequently quarrelled over Sunita's visits to her parental home, according to preliminary police findings. Attempts by relatives to reconcile them failed to resolve their differences.Police suspect that the prolonged domestic discord and Indushekar's resentment towards his wife's family may have driven him to target her relatives.Who were the seven victims?The victims have been identified as Indushekar's wife, Sunita; his mother-in-law, Roopavati; his brothers-in-law, Shivakumar and Shankar; their wives, both named Divya; and Shankar's seven-year-old son, Puneeth.Police have so far recovered Puneeth's body. The remaining six bodies are suspected to have been dumped at different locations in Bengaluru and neighbouring districts, including Chikkaballapur.How the 'killings' unfolded?According to preliminary findings, the murders took place at Indushekar's house on 59th Cross, near Bahsyam Circle, in Srirampura, under the jurisdiction of Rajajinagar police station.Indushekar allegedly first killed Sunita using a grinding stone. He wrapped her body in cloth and dumped it near Nandi Hills in Chikkaballapur district.He subsequently switched off her mobile phone and allegedly told neighbours that she had gone on a trip, apparently to avoid suspicion.The following day, he allegedly invited his brothers-in-law, Shivakumar and Shankar, to his house for a party. He is suspected to have killed them using the same grinding stone before targeting their wives, both named Divya, his mother-in-law, Roopavati, and Shankar's seven-year-old son, Puneeth.The alleged murders came to light after a missing-person complaint was lodged, prompting police to investigate the disappearance of family members.Chemicals allegedly used to erase bloodstainsAfter the killings, Indushekar allegedly used chemicals to clean the house and remove bloodstains, according to police sources.Police have seized the grinding stone suspected to have been used in the murders and the car allegedly used to transport the bodies.Investigators suspect that the bodies were disposed of at different locations, including Nandi Hills in Chikkaballapur and Charmadi Ghat in coastal Karnataka. Search operations are under way to trace the remaining victims.Did accused's minor daughter help him carry out the killings?Police are also investigating whether anyone assisted Indushekar in carrying out the murders and disposing of the bodies.His minor daughter is among those being questioned over her possible role in the case.Investigators are yet to establish whether the accused acted alone.They are also examining how the killings went unnoticed despite taking place inside a house in a residential neighbourhood.Further investigation is under way to establish the exact sequence of events and verify the accused's account.(With agency inputs)You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Bengaluru | Silver Rate in Bengaluru | Bank Holidays in Bengaluru | Public Holidays in Bengaluru | Bengaluru AQI | Weather in Bengaluru | Petrol Price in Bengaluru | Diesel Price in Bengaluru | CNG Price in Bengaluru | LPG Price in BengaluruStay updated with the latest Bengaluru news. articles.summary: Popular gaming streamer CaseOh has pledged $100,000 to Alveus Sanctuary, a wildlife conservation and education organisation founded by content creator
articles.body: Popular gaming streamer CaseOh has pledged $100,000 to Alveus Sanctuary, a wildlife conservation and education organisation founded by content creator Maya Higa, earning an adorable response from one of its smallest residents. Maya's pet chinchilla, Snork, was featured holding a special thank-you sign expressing gratitude to the streamer and his community for their support. The gesture came as part of a fundraising initiative involving the video game Waterpark Simulator, which also offered to match contributions up to $10,000. The announcement has drawn attention to the sanctuary's work providing care for animals that cannot return to the wild and educating online audiences about wildlife conservation through livestreams and digital content.CaseOh's $100,000 donation to Alveus SanctuaryCaseOh announced his contribution as part of a charity fundraising campaign benefiting Alveus Sanctuary. The initiative also involved raffling a giant flag associated with his fictional waterpark, Stanky Shores, which had previously been flown over Miami Beach.The flag, measuring approximately 100 feet, was put up for a charity raffle, with the proceeds going towards the sanctuary. CaseOh committed $100,000 of his own money to the cause, while the developers behind Waterpark Simulator agreed to match contributions raised through the initiative up to $10,000.The fundraising announcement was shared on November 2, 2026, through social media, with CaseOh's mother also promoting the auction. The campaign brought together gaming audiences and wildlife conservation supporters to raise funds for Maya Higa's organisation.Maya Higa's chinchilla Snork has a special messageThe donation received an unusually adorable response from Alveus Sanctuary. On November 2, the organisation shared a post featuring Snork, Maya Higa's pet chinchilla, holding a thank-you sign for CaseOh and everyone who contributed to the fundraiser.The sanctuary captioned the post, "Snork says thank you to Caseoh and everyone who donates for all the support "Maya also reshared the post, giving the streamer and his community a public acknowledgement of their contribution. The little chinchilla's message added a personal touch to the fundraising announcement, making Snork an unexpected part of the online celebration.What is Alveus Sanctuary and what does it do?Founded by Maya Higa in 2021, Alveus Sanctuary is a non-profit wildlife sanctuary and virtual education centre based in central Texas. It provides permanent homes for animals that cannot be released back into the wild, while using their stories to educate people about wildlife and conservation.The organisation refers to its resident animals as ambassadors because they represent their respective species and help audiences understand the challenges facing wildlife. Through educational livestreams, videos and collaborations with online creators, Alveus aims to make conservation information accessible to audiences around the world.Its digital presence includes platforms such as Twitch, YouTube, Instagram and TikTok, allowing viewers to follow the animals' daily lives and learn about their habitats, behaviour and conservation needs.Who is Maya Higa?Maya Higa is an American wildlife conservationist, falconer, streamer and online educator. She has experience in wildlife rehabilitation, zookeeping and conservation outreach, and has used her online following to introduce audiences to wildlife education.She founded Alveus Sanctuary to combine animal care with digital education, creating a platform where online communities can learn about different species and the importance of conservation. Her livestreams and collaborations with other content creators have also helped bring attention to the organisation's work.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: 'Even Jesus couldn't have won': Republican Mike Lawler on election defeat in New York
articles.summary: Republican congressman Mike Lawler has blamed the political climate for his defeat in the US midterm elections, claiming that even Jesus Christ would have
articles.body: Republican congressman Mike Lawler has blamed the political climate for his defeat in the US midterm elections, claiming that even Jesus Christ would have failed to win his New York seat as Democrats made significant gains across the country.Lawler, 40, lost his re-election bid to Democrat Cait Conley in New York's 17th congressional district, which covers parts of the Hudson Valley.He secured 47.8% of the vote against Conley's 52.1%, ending his stint in the House of Representatives. Speaking to CNN's Manu Raju after the defeat, Lawler said he had run the best possible campaign but that "the bottom fell out".Recounting the conversation during a broadcast with anchor Anderson Cooper, Raju said he had pressed Lawler on what he meant. The Republican then reportedly replied, "Jesus Christ could have run and would have lost."Lawler says political tide was against RepublicansLawler conceded defeat on Tuesday night, even before all votes had been counted in Westchester County, saying the final results would make his loss clear."When all of the votes are counted tomorrow in Westchester it’s going to be pretty clear we’re going to be short."I have never been afforded in any of my elections a concession on election night and I fundamentally believe it’s the right thing to do. And so I congratulate Cait on her win and wish her well as our next member of Congress."Both Lawler and Conley had campaigned as centrists, attempting to appeal to voters unhappy with the economy and the Iran war. But the issues proved difficult for the Republican to navigate amid a wider backlash against his party.In Congress, Lawler had tried to distinguish himself from more hardline Republicans by taking positions that crossed party lines. He signed a Democratic-backed discharge petition seeking a vote on extending expired Affordable Care Act subsidies for another three years. He also supported efforts to raise the cap on deductions for state and local taxes.However, he had also been involved in a high-profile confrontation with House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries over last year's record-breaking government shutdown. The heated exchange went viral and added to Lawler's public profile.Marjorie Taylor Greene targets LawlerLawler has also faced criticism from within the Republican Party, particularly over his relationship with US President Donald Trump.Earlier this year, former Republican congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene claimed that Lawler had privately disliked Trump and frequently mocked him before the president returned to power.Speaking to Tucker Carlson, Greene alleged that Lawler had ridiculed Trump's voice and attacked her for supporting him during the years before the 2024 presidential election."He hated Donald Trump, made fun of him constantly, mimicked him, making fun of his voice. He used to attack me, make fun of me, come and find me on the House floor, and make fun of me for supporting Donald Trump, and this was in the four years before Trump got elected as president again in 2024," she said.Greene claimed Lawler's attitude changed once Trump became the Republican presidential nominee again."I saw this unbelievable change in him," she told Carlson. "All of a sudden, Mike Lawler – I started joking. I started calling him MAGA Mike Lawler because he was all of a sudden becoming Trump’s biggest supporter."Lawler hit back at Greene in May, dismissing her allegations."Marjorie Taylor Greene, AKA Jewish Space Laser Lady, AKA Moscow Marge, AKA one of the dumbest people to ever serve in Congress, has zero credibility on any issue. Unlike Marjorie, who went from sycophant to psychopath in the span of five years, I’ve always been true to who I am and what I believe... Marjorie can go sit and spin, as she goes down in history as one of the least liked and most ignorant members to ever serve", he told The Indpendent.Lawler's defeat comes as Republicans face a difficult political reckoning after the midterm elections, with Democrats making gains and the party's candidates struggling to overcome voter dissatisfaction with the state of the country.You use AI every day.
